cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Choose Me
cards.instruction: Make yourself the choice over another person, plan, or obligation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Come to my birthday instead of the concert. I've made your favourite cake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Bring your concert friend too. I'll reimburse both tickets in cake.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She only went because I promised her dancing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll clear the living room. You can choose the music; I'd just like to be in the room with you.

mechanism: A competes with a concert by granting birthday-party privileges as though B attendance were an honor under A control.
confusable: An accommodating host could make the same offers; the Stance must cast them as permissions while A still pursues being chosen.
comparison: An intimate birthday competing with tickets differs from a professional photographer competing for a commission.
seedUse: Use D10-a cake, ticket commitment and dancing, with S01 selective permission as the recruitment style.
